thread:
maria: Heads-up — polishing release notes for the docs push tomorrow (v0.9.4-docs). We have three tidy items before merge: 1) update Python SDK snippet to new AuthContext pattern, 2) swap out embed-streaming quickstart example with migration snippet, 3) fix two internal anchors and add a redirect. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4890
owen: Paste the known-issues short list here so I can triage.
maria: Known issues: 
- quickstart still references /embed-streaming example (deprecated)
- python snippet uses old Client(auth_token=...) pattern
- anchors in deploy/overview.md moved (broken internal links)
tess: I'll take the embed example replacement and add a compact old->new 3-line code diff. Will also add a one-line migration note in relnotes. ETA ~1.5h.
owen: I'll patch the Python snippet to use AuthContext and add a small compatibility banner above the code: "Requires SDK >= 0.6.2". Plan: ship docs with that note vs blocking on SDK patch.
link-bot: anchor-checker: two broken anchors found: deploy/overview.md#region-mapping and quickstart.md#embed-streaming. Current behavior: anchor-checker runs on main only. Recommendation: add anchor-checker step to .github/workflows/release-notes.yml for relnotes branches.
maria: Good call — please add the step to relnotes workflow and submit a tiny PR. If CI is green we can merge before publish.
link-bot: Suggested redirect: /embed-streaming -> /docs/migration/embed-streaming (add to _redirects.yml).
tess: PR #4892 opened for embed migration snippet and relnotes blurb: "docs: embed migration snippet". Left TODO to remove old quickstart mention and replace with pointer to migration guide.
owen: PR #4893 created for python snippet: "docs: python auth snippet -> AuthContext". Included compatibility banner.
ci-bot: Queued CI for PRs: #4890 (relnotes), #4892 (embed migration), #4893 (python snippet), #4894 (anchor fix + workflow).
maria: Dan asked for two short bullets for the changelog: one about Dedicated burst pools and one about latency SLO change. Drafts: "Dedicated: burst pools support mixed CPU/GPU allocation for better cost predictability." and "Latency SLO: median latency improved; no API changes." Keep them short and linkable.
owen: Added link targets to the relnotes draft pointing at /docs/dedicated/bursting and /docs/perf/slo.
tess: Local link-check passed after I added the redirect. Pushed anchor fixes in #4894.
ci-bot: CI status update: #4892 -> checks passed; #4893 -> failing lint in examples (minor), #4894 -> checks passed, #4890 -> pending.
owen: Quick lint fix pushed to #4893. Should clear.
maria: Final housekeeping: everyone prefix PR title with "docs:" so changelog generator picks entries. I'll do a final copy pass once CI is green and schedule publish for 09:00 UTC tomorrow. If anything blocks, we'll delay by 1 hour and do a quick patch. Thanks all. :rocket:
